headline: Updates on Lions Club collaboration, MOD Grant, MBTA accessibility forum, and Vision 2026 framework topics.
summary: The Disability Commission will review updates on current projects including the Lions Club Collaboration, the MOD Grant, and a possible MBTA Accessibility public forum. The meeting will also cover Vision 2026 framework topics, new business including UMA Board representation and White Cane Awareness Month, and public comment.
